inspectionMethod: Root personally viewed all 10 labelled contact sheets (60 original GPU captures), and full-size shore, sailing, splash, damage, crew impact, dismast, sinking, optics baseline/refraction/both views.

findings.observed: Bright readable blue-green sea, moving white shoreline bands, docks and distant islands supported by terrain; no rectangular wake background.
Spatial white column, cap and expanding water rings visible in overhead and low views; finite per-event lifetime.
Hull remains solid, original organic sail holes replace dot grid; falling masts carry sails, yards, rigging and flag.
3D crew stand on deck; actual salvos displace physical bodies; impact and recovery frames agree with diagnostics.
Identical authority snapshots show pier/ship reflection and shallow-water difference; no broad screen-feedback block in sampled camera views.
Product helm/broadside states readable, QA narrow view scrollable; low/high variants rendered.

limitations: Fixed accepted ticks are image acceptance only, not measured FPS.
Contact sheets are derived viewing aids; original PNG pixels were not edited.
Screenspace reflections omit offscreen and transparent objects.
Sampled images do not prove all possible camera angles, hardware, campaign content, or exhaustive collision configurations.
